Supreme Court orders developer to pay homebuyers within a week

The Supreme Court has given Parsvnath Developers one week to pay its homebuyers. The court warned that the company's directors could face jail if they fail to comply with the order. This action follows concerns that the system has been "hijacked" in the case.
